MAC_rule: one complete logical multiply-accumulate counts as2OP when this convention is supported; never replace by physical bitOP
formats: Names and widths retained independently; analog b_R remains null absent a logical codebook. Bit-packed integer logical payload is used at local service boundaries.
rate_fields: rho and tau each have two orthogonal evidence labels plus performance_kind, bound_role, nature and unknown_reason.
null_policy: null with reason; zero never denotes unknown.
task3: task3_hardware_export.json includes selected and unselected records; only entries with pair_compatibility.compatible true may supply a numerical ridge. Reference scenarios exported separately.
discovery_candidate_policy: Bibliographic leads with inaccessible full text are in sources/manifest.json and coverage.json, not fabricated full hardware records.
